name: Suspicious Advpack Call Via Rundll32.EXE
description: Detects execution of "rundll32" calling "advpack.dll" with potential obfuscated ordinal calls in order to leverage the "RegisterOCX" function
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*\\rundll32.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:RUNDLL32.EXE OR process.command_line:*rundll32*) AND process.command_line:*advpack* AND ((process.command_line:*#\+* AND process.command_line:*12*) OR process.command_line:*#\-*)
